title.zh: OpenCode 2.0重写底层：MCP工具能用代码串联，多个Agent可后台并行干活
title.en: OpenCode 2.0重写底层：MCP工具能用代码串联，多个Agent可后台并行干活

current_state.zh: OpenCode 2.0 rewrites its architecture around a Code Mode that turns MCP services and OpenAPI endpoints into chainable JavaScript functions, adds a shared local backend service with parallel background sub-agents and 80+ hot-loadable plugins, and ships an embeddable SDK that Cloudflare now supports experimentally via Durable Objects.
current_state.en: OpenCode 2.0 rewrites its architecture around a Code Mode that turns MCP services and OpenAPI endpoints into chainable JavaScript functions, adds a shared local backend service with parallel background sub-agents and 80+ hot-loadable plugins, and ships an embeddable SDK that Cloudflare now supports experimentally via Durable Objects.
